chinese: 我和我的朋友们每周在一个专门的公园练习两次。
english: My friends and I practise at a special park twice a week.

chinese: 我的滑板真的很酷，他们的也是。
english: My skateboard is really cool, and so are theirs.

chinese: 我们互相鼓励做技巧动作。
english: We encourage one another to do tricks.

chinese: 有些技巧很难，但一旦成功，感觉棒极了！
english: Some tricks are difficult, but once you succeed, you feel great!

chinese: 我喜欢玩滑板是因为它能让我保持健康。
english: I like skateboarding because it keeps me fit.
